Same values, but not the same reference. That's almost always the reason.

A few common causes:

- The child isn't wrapped in `React.memo`, so it re-renders whenever the parent does, no matter what the props are.
- You're passing an inline function or object, like `onClick={() => ...}` or `style={{...}}`. Each render makes a brand new one, so React sees it as "changed."
- A parent higher up is re-rendering and passing down new arrays or objects each time, even if the contents look identical.
- Context values are changing, which re-renders every component reading that context.

The fix is usually two things together: wrap the child in `React.memo`, and make sure the props you pass it are stable, using `useCallback` for functions and `useMemo` for objects or arrays.

If you share the parent and child code, I can point to the exact spot causing it.
